integrity: Theorem justified by finite exact local classification and analytic shell counting; supplemental finite tests are not used as proofs of infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: The two-cylinder set is an explicit subset, not a classification of all unrepresentable integers. Necessity of the three-bit test does not imply sufficiency. The full-set lower bound need not be sharp; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Two sharp three-bit obstructions for binary palindromic quotients
